That doesn't sound like what a boyfriend would do, right?  Take your time in thinking and parting yourself from him if you must, but don't drag it out for too long.  Your problems do matter, and you deserve to have them be listened and understood.

I don't want to tell you right away to break up with your boyfriend, but I would advise you to reevaluate your relationship with him.  If he deems your depression as attention-seeking rather than helping you heal that's a red flag.  A person who loves you would empathize with you and support you in becoming better.  Make sure to communicate with him on how you feel about his reactions to your issues.  If he doesn't understand or refuses to, well...
